packMeta.name: SitePulse (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey construction site diary and builder command hub: active projects overview, daily site diaries with weather & sign-off, defect snag list, client-approved variations, deliveries log, and subcontractor insurance expiry tracking. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
